cases.question: How many victory points does a player need to win?
cases.reference_answer: The first player to reach 10 victory points on their turn wins.

cases.question: How does each player get their starting resource cards?
cases.reference_answer: Each player takes the resource cards matching the hexes adjacent to their second settlement.

cases.question: How is the first player chosen?
cases.reference_answer: Each player rolls the dice, and the player with the highest roll goes first.

cases.question: What does the Road Building development card let its player do?
cases.reference_answer: Build two roads at no cost.

cases.question: How many victory points is a city worth?
cases.reference_answer: A city is worth two victory points.

cases.question: How many cards does each player receive as their starting hand?
cases.reference_answer: Each player receives one card.

cases.question: What does a player do with cards on their turn?
cases.reference_answer: They draw one card, then choose and play one of their two cards.

cases.question: What can cause a round to end?
cases.reference_answer: The deck runs out, or only one player remains in the round.

cases.question: How can a player win a round?
cases.reference_answer: Be the only player left, or have the highest-value card when the round ends.

cases.question: How many favor tokens are needed to win with four players?
cases.reference_answer: A player needs four favor tokens.

cases.question: What must the players do to win?
cases.reference_answer: Discover cures for all four diseases.

cases.question: How many outbreaks cause the players to lose?
cases.reference_answer: The players lose when eight outbreaks occur.

cases.question: How many actions does a player take on their turn?
cases.reference_answer: A player takes four actions.

cases.question: When a disease outbreak occurs, what happens to connected cities?
cases.reference_answer: Place one cube of the outbreak's disease color in every connected city.

cases.question: How many player cards are drawn during the draw step of a turn?
cases.reference_answer: Draw two player cards.

cases.question: When taking tiles from a factory, which tiles must a player take?
cases.reference_answer: All tiles of one chosen color from that factory.

cases.question: Where do the tiles left in a factory go after a player takes a color?
cases.reference_answer: The remaining tiles from that factory move to the center of the table.

cases.question: What happens to tiles placed in a player's floor line?
cases.reference_answer: They count as fallen tiles and give minus points during the wall-tiling phase.

cases.question: What triggers the end of the game?
cases.reference_answer: The game ends after a round in which a player completes a horizontal line of five tiles on their wall.

cases.question: How many bonus points does each complete horizontal line score at the end of the game?
cases.reference_answer: Each complete horizontal line of five tiles scores two bonus points.
